text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan is an utterly clumsy and 
awkward Umamusume. Because of that, 
teachers easily misunderstand her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her friends, however, knew the truth. They 
knew that despite her fragile hooves 
holding her back, she wanted to win and 
was trying twice as hard as anyone else.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"...Whether aware of that or not, there 
were some who pestered her in bizarre 
ways."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so began our days taking on the 
Twinkle Series with Tosen Jordan!
